_about: Birth dates (born, YYYY-MM-DD, 00 for an unknown month or day) for people the GEDCOM file leaves undated, keyed by person id. Applied by scripts/gedcom-to-saga.mts on import, only where the file has no date. Found by web search (Wikipedia, Wikidata). Bansi Dhar Nehru, Shyamlal Nehru and Gunottam Hutheesing: none found.
